title: CatalogEntry
description: A single catalog entry. Stages 2 + 3 + 4 + 7 F7.1 + 7 F7.3 ship `substrate` + `hardscape` + `plant` + `livestock` + `equipment`. Future stages add tank under the same oneOf. Manifest schemaVersion 3 (Stage 11 F11.2) adds the optional `behavior` block on `LivestockEntry`; v2 manifests load unchanged because every behavior subfield is optional + additive (`resolveBehavior()` falls back to per-group presets when the block is absent). Stage 11 F11.3 extends the same v3 schema additively with `behavior.territory` / `nipping` / `fear` on livestock and `coverScore` on hardscape — no manifest version bump. Stage 11 F11.4 extends the same v3 schema additively with `behavior.feeding` / `curiosity` on livestock — no manifest version bump. Stage 11 F11.5 extends the same v3 schema additively with `flow` (filter / pump outflow + intake + flowRate) and `airRateMl` (air-stone bubble volumetric rate) on equipment — no manifest version bump.

silhouette.description: Convex-ish closed polygon outline in normalized [-1, 1] space. The renderer scales each point by (naturalSize × transform.scale × 0.5) so the silhouette spans the natural footprint at scale 1.

coverScore.description: Stage 11 F11.3 FearSystem refuge value. When absent, the loader fills it from `category` (wood → 0.6, rock → 0.4, other → 0). JSON Schema's `default` is metadata only — the fill happens in the loader, not in the validator.

weeksToMature.description: Wall-clock weeks from a fresh trim to mature size for an average specimen at vigor = 1.

sizeAtZero.description: Scale (relative to mature) at week 0. Carpet plants typically start as plugs at ~0.3; rosettes at ~0.5.

defaultDensity.description: Suggested scatter density (instances per 100 cm²) when the planting tool's carpet brush drops this plant. Only meaningful for carpet-zone species.

adultSize.description: Typical adult body length in millimetres.

temperatureRange.description: Water temperature tolerance window in Celsius. Manifest authors must ensure minC < maxC; JSON Schema cannot enforce cross-field comparisons declaratively.

pHRange.description: Water pH tolerance window. Manifest authors must ensure min < max; JSON Schema cannot enforce cross-field comparisons declaratively.

schoolingMin.description: Minimum recommended group size. 1 = solitary / non-schooling.

compatibilityFlags.description: Pre-baked answers for the Stage 7 F7.2 compatibility rule engine.

behavior.description: Stage 11 F11.2 per-species overrides for the schooling + vertical-stratification + animation params. Every subfield is optional; absent fields fall back to the per-group preset via `resolveBehavior()` in `@aquascape/domain/livestock-behaviors`. Manifests authored before schemaVersion 3 lack this block entirely and load unchanged.

schooling.description: Couzin 2002 three-zone + Reynolds 1987 weighted steering. Distances in millimetres; speeds in mm/sec.

ZOR.description: Zone of repulsion radius (mm). Below this, neighbours push us away.

ZOO.description: Zone of orientation radius (mm). Between ZOR and ZOO, headings align.

ZOA.description: Zone of attraction radius (mm). Between ZOO and ZOA, steer toward centroid.

blindAngle.description: Blind cone behind the fish (radians, total angle subtended). Range [0, π].

noise.description: Per-tick noise magnitude as a fraction of vPref. Typical 0..0.2.

depth.description: Vertical-stratification spring centred on a preferred fraction of tank height.

preferredY.description: Preferred Y as a fraction of tank height (0 = substrate, 1 = waterline).

bandWidth.description: Band half-width as a fraction of tank height. Inside this, only noise applies.

returnForce.description: Restoring force magnitude when outside the band (mm/sec² equivalent).

animation.description: Carangiform tail-beat parameters consumed by the renderer-3d vertex shader.

ampHead.description: Amplitude at the head end (fraction of body length).

ampTail.description: Amplitude at the tail tip (fraction of body length).

envelopeExp.description: Spine envelope exponent in `amp(s) = ampHead + (ampTail−ampHead) * pow(s, env)`.

oneOf.description: Stage 11 F11.3 territoriality params (Brown 1964 + Adams 2001). All subfields optional — only declared keys override the per-species heuristic; absent keys fall back to the heuristic's defaults.

coreRadius.description: Inner defense radius (mm). Non-conspecifics inside this get chased.

displayRadius.description: Outer display radius (mm). Owner posts but does not chase between core and display.

aggression.description: Chase-force magnitude (mm/sec² equivalent). Higher = more aggressive pursuit.

fatigueRate.description: Per-second decay rate of accumulated fatigue. Scales chase force downward over sustained defense.

oneOf.description: Explicit `null` opts OUT of the per-species heuristic — e.g. a peaceful dwarf cichlid that should NOT inherit the cichlid territory default.
Stage 11 F11.3 fin-nipping params (Keenleyside 1955 + Magurran 1990). All subfields optional.

groupThreshold.description: Minimum conspecific count visible nearby to suppress nipping. Below this, the fish nips.

finFraction.description: Minimum fraction of body length the target's longest fin must reach to be a candidate.

rate.description: Per-second Poisson rate at which an eligible nip attempt fires when conditions hold.

oneOf.description: Explicit `null` opts OUT of the per-species nipping heuristic.

fear.description: Stage 11 F11.3 anti-predator / fear params (Lima & Dill 1990). No `| null` — every fish carries fear; manifest authors can only tune values.

riskBaseline.description: Baseline anxiety added to every tick's risk integration. Higher = always-jumpy species.

threshold.description: Risk level above which the FORAGE → REFUGE mode flip fires.

coverPreference.description: Which hardscape coverScore source the species prefers when seeking a refuge. `'any'` = no preference (nearest cover wins).

emergenceDelay.description: Seconds to wait in REFUGE mode after risk drops below threshold before flipping back to FORAGE.

feeding.description: Stage 11 F11.4 feeding params. `category` drives FeedingSystem target selection (surface flake vs. midwater pellet vs. substrate wafer, plus algae-grazer / plant-eater / detritivore passive uptake). No `| null` — every fish has hunger; absent fields fall back to per-species defaults via `resolveBehavior()`.

hungerRatePerSec.description: Per-second hunger accrual. Higher = species reads as visibly hungry faster between feedings.

threshold.description: Hunger level above which the fish actively seeks food. Typically in [0, 2]; can exceed 1 for species that tolerate longer fasts before showing it.

category.description: Feeding-strategy bucket consumed by FeedingSystem target selection.

curiosity.description: Stage 11 F11.4 curiosity / glass-surfing params. Drives the chance + duration of the glass-surf investigation behavior. No `| null` — `ratePerSec = 0` is the documented way to disable glass-surfing entirely for a species.

boldness.description: How likely a curious bout is to fire when an opportunity presents itself. 0 = always shy, 1 = always investigates.

ratePerSec.description: Per-second Poisson rate at which a curiosity bout fires. 0 disables glass-surfing entirely for the species.

dwellSec.description: Seconds the fish lingers at the investigated target before returning to FORAGE.

flowRateLph.description: Manufacturer-published flow rate (litres per hour). Filter-specific; ignored for other categories.

coverageLitres.description: Recommended tank-size window. Either bound is optional; both are positive integers when present.

defaultSettings.description: Seed settings the future settings UI populates on first attach. F7.3 v1 is display-only; shape mirrors the document-side EquipmentEntry.settings Record.

flow.description: Stage 11 F11.5 flow contribution for filter / pump equipment. Drives the FlowFieldSystem source/sink bake. Every subfield is optional + additive — older manifests without `flow` keep loading unchanged.

outflowPos.description: World-space position where water exits the equipment (mm). Right-handed, +x right, +y up, +z back.

outflowVec.description: Direction vector of the outflow jet (unit-ish). Default (0, 0, 1) — points toward back of tank.

intakePos.description: World-space position where water enters the equipment intake (mm). Optional — when absent, the intake is co-located with `outflowPos`.

flowRate.description: Volumetric flow rate (L/hr). Drives source/sink strength. Default 200.

airRateMl.description: Stage 11 F11.5 air-stone air volumetric rate (mL/min). Drives BubbleParticleSystem spawn rate. When absent, the equipment is not an air-stone (or produces no visible bubbles).
